main_text.l: [engraving: angels blowing trumpets above a church; the dead rising from graves and gathering below. Described under notes.]

l.i: Meta æui, clangorq; tubæ, reparatioq; huius
Quisquis aues gelida surgere faustus humo.

page.notes: The woodcut shows two angels with trumpets in the upper sky, a church with a tower at right, and a crowd of resurrected figures rising from tombs at lower left and right. The verse lines are printed in italic, centred, and read as transcribed. The word "Paucis" at lower right is a separate printed note. The running head word EMBLEMA is set in spaced capitals. The verse line "Pietateq;(age)" retains the printed parenthesis.
